question: The default width of a column in MS-Excel is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**8 characters**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **default width of a column **in MS-Excel is **8 characters**.
 
• This width is set to accommodate the average width of characters in the default font.
 
• Users can manually adjust the width of columns to fit their data requirements.
 
• To change the column width, you can drag the boundary on the right side of the column heading or use the "Format" option under the "Home" tab.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5332820fd51cb38d36fa3ee76973229b1d5979c311bc5b5d0b25fd6d5aa87c4.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Microsoft Excel** is a spreadsheet program included in the Microsoft Office suite of applications.
 
• It features calculation, graphing tools, pivot tables, and a macro programming language called VBA (Visual Basic for Applications).
 
• Excel is widely used for data analysis, financial modeling, and other tasks involving numerical data.
 
• Users can customize various aspects of Excel, including column widths, to better suit their specific needs and preferences.
